location: I2-060-MemberShape and ship-level SPARQL constraints using nltl:memberInstability on ?member
problem: The authoritative vocabulary context assigns nltl:memberInstability requiredOwner ship, but the candidate constrains and queries it as a property of each structuralMember.
required_change: Evaluate nltl:memberInstability from its authoritative ship-owned location, using an explicit relationship or path to associate the instability result with the applicable member while preserving the cut-out applicability condition.
regression_guard: Preserve ship as the owner of nltl:memberInstability and retain the requirement that applicable members must not cause instability.
